arxiv-1710-08556.title: Biermann battery-mediated magnetic reconnection in 3-D colliding plasmas
arxiv-1710-08556.creator: J. Matteucci, W. Fox, A. Bhattacharjee, D. B. Schaeffer, C. Moissard, K. Germaschewski, G. Fiksel, S. X. Hu
arxiv-1710-08556.description: Abstract Recent experiments have demonstrated magnetic reconnection between colliding plasma plumes, where the reconnecting magnetic fields were self-generated in the plasma by the Biermann battery effect. Using fully kinetic 3-D simulations, we show the full evolution of the magnetic fields and plasma in these experiments including self-consistent magnetic field generation about the expanding plume.

arxiv-2003-01427.title: Aging Touch: Systematic and Unbiased Presentation of Tactile Stimuli Journal: Technical Report Volume: – Issue: – DOI: – Publication type: –
arxiv-2003-01427.creator: Claudio Zito
arxiv-2003-01427.description: Abstract This report presents the experimental methodology and a step-by-step guide for gathering data on how aging influences tactile surface perception in decision and action. The experiments consist of a set of trials in which the ability to distinguish tactile stimuli is investigated. A robot arm is used to provide a systematic and unbiased presentation of the stimuli.

arxiv-2102-05166.title: Discrete Bessel and Mathieu functions
arxiv-2102-05166.description: Abstract The two-dimensional Helmholtz equation separates in elliptic coordinates based on two distinct foci, a limit case of which includes polar coordinate systems when the two foci coalesce. This equation is invariant under the Euclidean group of translations and orthogonal transformations; we replace the latter by the discrete dihedral group of N N discrete rotations and reflections.

arxiv-2103-05066.description: Abstract Since the first experimental observation of all-optical switching phenomena, intensive research has been focused on finding suitable magnetic systems that can be integrated as storage elements within spintronic devices and whose magnetization can be controlled through ultra-short single laser pulses.

arxiv-2209-15026.title: Reconstruction wedges in AdS/CFT with boundary fractal-like structures
arxiv-2209-15026.creator: Ning Bao, Joydeep Naskar
arxiv-2209-15026.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ning Bao, Joydeep Naskar. In this work, we show the robustness of uberholography and its associated quantum error correcting code against the breakdown of entanglement wedge in the presence of highly entropic mixed states in the bulk. We show that for Cantor-set-like erasure in the boundary in A ​ d ​ S 3 / C ​ F ​ T 2 AdS_{3}/CFT_{2} , the code distance is independent of the mixed-state entropy in the bulk in the m → ∞ m\rightarrow\infty limit.

arxiv-2211-07202.title: Parallel Downlink Data Distribution in Indoor Multi-hop THz Networks
arxiv-2211-07202.creator: Cao Vien Phung, Andre Drummond and Admela Jukan
arxiv-2211-07202.description: Abstract The emerging dynamic Virtual Reality (VR) applications are the best candidate applications in high bandwidth indoor Terahertz (THz) wireless networks, with the Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) devices presenting a breakthrough solution in extending the typically short THz communication range and alleviating line-of-sight link blockages.

arxiv-2308-06747.title: How synchronized human networks escape local minima
arxiv-2308-06747.creator: Elad Schniderman, Yahav Avraham, Shir Shahal, Hamootal Duadi, Nir Davidson, Moti Fridman
arxiv-2308-06747.description: Abstract Finding the global minimum in complex networks while avoiding local minima is challenging in many types of networks. We study the dynamics of complex human networks and observed that humans have different methods to avoid local minima than other networks. Humans can change the coupling strength between them or change their tempo.

arxiv-2405-16032.title: p p -adic equidistribution of modular geodesics and of Heegner points on Shimura curves
arxiv-2405-16032.creator: Patricio Pérez-Piña
arxiv-2405-16032.description: Abstract . We propose a p p -adic version of Duke’s Theorem on the equidistribution of closed geodesics on modular curves. Our approach concerns quadratic fields split at p p as well as a p p -adic covering of the modular curve.

arxiv-2408-08382.title: Improved Approximation Algorithms for Index Coding
arxiv-2408-08382.creator: Dror Chawin, Ishay Haviv
arxiv-2408-08382.description: Abstract The index coding problem is concerned with broadcasting encoded information to a collection of receivers in a way that enables each receiver to discover its required data based on its side information, which comprises the data required by some of the others.

arxiv-2410-12841.title: UniAutoML: A Human-Centered Framework for Unified Discriminative and Generative AutoML with Large Language Models
arxiv-2410-12841.creator: Jiayi Guo, Zan Chen, Yingrui Ji, Liyun Zhang, Daqin Luo, Zhigang Li, Yiqin Shen
arxiv-2410-12841.description: Abstract Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) can streamline the complexities of machine learning pipelines. However, existing AutoML frameworks focus on discriminative tasks leaving generative tasks unexplored. Moreover, existing AutoML frameworks often lack interpretability and user engagement during the model development and training process, due to the absence of human-centered designs.

arxiv-2412-20015.title: A Family of Vertex Algebras from Argyres-Douglas Theory
arxiv-2412-20015.creator: Heeyeon Kim, and Jaewon Song
arxiv-2412-20015.description: Abstract We find that multiple vertex algebras can arise from a single 4d 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 superconformal field theory (SCFT). The connection is given by the BPS monodromy operator M M , which is a wall-crossing invariant quantity that captures the BPS spectrum on the Coulomb branch.

arxiv-2506-23399.description: Abstract . We consider the Edge Multiway Cut problem on planar graphs. It is known that this can be solved in n O ⁡ ( t ) n^{{O}(\sqrt{t})} time [Klein, Marx, ICALP 2012] and not in n O ⁡ ( t ) n^{{O}(\sqrt{t})} time under the Exponential Time Hypothesis [Marx, ICALP 2012], where t t is the number of terminals.

arxiv-2510-18510.title: Identity-Aware Large Language Models require Cultural Reasoning
arxiv-2510-18510.creator: Alistair Plum, Anne-Marie Lutgen, Christoph Purschke, Achim Rettinger
arxiv-2510-18510.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alistair Plum, Anne-Marie Lutgen, Christoph Purschke, Achim Rettinger. Large language models have become the latest trend in natural language processing, heavily featuring in the digital tools we use every day. However, their replies often reflect a narrow cultural viewpoint that overlooks the diversity of global users.

arxiv-2601-20655.title: OnePiece: A Large-Scale Distributed Inference System with RDMA for Complex AI-Generated Content (AIGC) Workflows
arxiv-2601-20655.creator: June Chen, Neal Xu, Gragas Huang, Bok Zhou, Stephen Liu
arxiv-2601-20655.description: Abstract . The rapid growth of AI-generated content (AIGC) has enabled high-quality creative production across diverse domains, yet existing systems face critical inefficiencies in throughput, resource utilization, and scalability under concurrent workloads. This paper introduces OnePiece, a large-scale distributed inference system with RDMA optimized for multi-stage AIGC workflows.

pmc-11440938.title: OrgaMapper: a robust and easy-to-use workflow for analyzing organelle positioning
pmc-11440938.creator: Christopher Schmied, Michael Ebner, Paula Samsó, Rozemarijn Van Der Veen, Volker Haucke, Martin Lehmann
pmc-11440938.description: BackgroundEukaryotic cells are highly compartmentalized by a variety of organelles that carry out specific cellular processes. The position of these organelles within the cell is elaborately regulated and vital for their function. For instance, the position of lysosomes relative to the nucleus controls their degradative capacity and is altered in pathophysiological conditions.

pmc-11690021.description: Hearing loss is common among older adults and is linked to poor physical function, but whether hearing aid use may slow physical function declines remains unknown. We investigated the association between hearing loss and functional status in older adults and modifying effects of hearing aid use.

pmc-13696681.title: Astrocytes modulate the effects of cocaine in low frequency neuro-vascular oscillations in mice
pmc-13696681.creator: Qiaochu Wang, Yanzuo Liu, Hyomin Jeong, Nora D. Volkow, Yingtian Pan, Congwu Du
pmc-13696681.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Low-frequency oscillations (LFOs) in neurovascular system reflect brain activity and are disrupted by cocaine, likely contributing to its neuropathological effects. However, cellular mechanisms underlying this disruption remain poorly understood. We utilize a multimodal imaging platform (MIP) integrating GCaMP6f-based calcium fluorescence imaging and optical coherence Doppler tomography to investigate how acute and chronic cocaine alter LFOs within the neuro-astroglio-vascular (NAV) network in prefrontal cortex (PFC) of isoflurane-anesthetized mice. Astrocytes are selectively modulated via GFAP-DREADDs(Gi) to assess their roles in regulating LFOs.

uslaw-usc-t42-s426.title: 42 U.S.C. § 426 — Entitlement to hospital insurance benefits
uslaw-usc-t42-s426.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s426.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 7 (Social Security); Subchapter II (Federal Old-Age, Survivors, And Disability Insurance Benefits). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Individuals over 65 years Every individual who— (1) has attained age 65, and (2) (A) is entitled to monthly insurance benefits under section 402 of this title, would be entitled to those benefits.
